caption: First-person POV opens on a sunlit concrete rooftop car park with painted yellow and white bay markings; the runner's elongated shadow stretches ahead. At ~00:01 a figure in a full black hooded robe wearing a white Ghostface (Scream) mask lunges into frame from the right, triggering the chase. The camera whips left and sprints toward an open-air stairwell flanked by grey bollards with orange reflective tops, past a small brick kiosk and metal fencing.
visual: Bright midday light, blue sky, modern multi-storey building with louvered facade in background. Runner's bare forearms and black pants visible at frame edges. Ghostface mask: white with black drooping eyes and mouth. Stairwell entrance with handrails ahead.
audio: Aggressive trap/electronic beat with distorted 808 bass and rapid hi-hats starts immediately; heavy panicked breathing and slapping footfalls on concrete.

caption: The runner descends an external zig-zag metal staircase; the Ghostface pursuer is visible several flights above at ~00:06. The runner grabs the tubular steel handrail (~00:10) and slides down it, feet dangling, then drops to the next flight, continuing to slide and hop between stair sections while the masked figure pursues below/above through the railings.
visual: Concrete steps, silver railings, strong striped shadows of railings on walls. Runner's black sneakers with white soles visible during slide. Camera tilts and rolls with each descent.
audio: Music continues; metallic scraping/clanging of the rail slide, thuds of landings, continuous panting and grunts of exertion.

caption: Reaching ground level beside a roller-shutter door, the runner spins; the Ghostface figure closes in brandishing a long blade/knife (~00:20-00:23). The runner grabs the attacker's arm/hood and shoves them backward (~00:24-00:25), sending the masked figure stumbling near the shutter, then bolts away across the paved plaza.
visual: Grey corrugated shutter wall, concrete ground, manhole covers, distant trees and street lamp. Close-up of white mask and black glove holding silver blade. Runner's hands push the figure's chest/arm.
audio: Music intensifies; scuffle sounds, a grunt/yell, fabric rustle, then sprinting footfalls resume.

caption: The runner dashes into the dim interior of the multi-level car park, weaving past square columns painted blue on top and white below, parked sedans, and yellow floor arrows. The Ghostface figure is glimpsed in the distance behind (~00:32). The runner exits into daylight onto a narrow service walkway bordered by a dark textured retaining wall studded with square metal anchor plates.
visual: Fluorescent ceiling lights, blue/white pillars, parked cars, yellow directional arrows on grey concrete. Transition from shadow to bright sun; runner's shadow cast on wall.
audio: Echoing footfalls indoors, panting, music steady; ambient hum of garage.

caption: Along the walkway the runner vaults a low mesh fence panel (~00:39-00:41), lands on gravel and dry leaves, and pushes through an open galvanised mesh gate. The Ghostface pursuer appears pressed against the mesh behind the gate (~00:44), then the runner slams/passes the gate and continues along the concrete path beside a white brick wall.
visual: Diamond-pattern steel mesh fencing, grey brick wall, scattered brown leaves, bright sun with lens flare. Masked figure visible through mesh grid.
audio: Metallic rattle of fence and gate, footfalls on gravel then concrete, heavy breathing, music continues.

caption: The runner glances back (~00:49-00:52): the Ghostface figure is climbing over the dark anchor-studded retaining wall in pursuit. The runner keeps sprinting down the narrow passage between the wall and the building, passing another mesh gate (~00:56-00:58) which they swing through while the pursuer's shadow looms.
visual: Steep dark wall with rows of square silver anchor plates, white drainpipe, blue sky strip above. Runner's hand touches gate mesh. Masked figure scaling wall in background.
audio: Panting, scuffing footsteps, gate clang, driving music.

caption: The runner rounds a corner past a large ribbed metal water tank, descends a short flight of concrete stairs into a darker garage level (~01:04-01:06), and approaches a grey metal door bearing a handwritten paper sign reading "Fire exit / Authorized personnel only" (~01:08).
visual: Corrugated silver tank, yellow floor markings, dim fluorescent lighting, concrete stairwell, white paper sign taped to door with black marker text.
audio: Footsteps echo more in enclosed space; breathing; music continues.

caption: The runner shoves past the fire-exit door into a ramped garage area; the Ghostface figure emerges from the stairwell behind (~01:10-01:14). The runner grabs a black wheeled rubbish bin (~01:15) and hurls it at the pursuer (~01:16-01:17), then sprints down another concrete staircase to escape.
visual: Grey ramp, metal guardrail, orange traffic cone, green bin in distance, black wheelie bin in foreground. Masked figure with blade at top of stairs. Handwritten sign visible on door at start of segment.
audio: Loud plastic/metal crash of bin impact, grunts, rapid footfalls descending stairs, music pounding.

caption: Emerging outdoors, the runner scrambles up the steep dark retaining wall using its square anchor plates as footholds (~01:23-01:26), pulls onto the top ledge, and runs along a narrow path beside a chain-link fence overlooking a lower courtyard, then leaps down (~01:32) onto concrete.
visual: Close-up of hands gripping anchor plates, chain-link fence, mulch garden bed below, blue sky, building with external stairs in background. Lens flare from sun.
audio: Scraping of shoes on wall, breathing, thud of landing, music continues.

caption: The runner crosses a paved terrace toward a curved grey metal-clad wall, vaults over its rounded top (~01:39-01:41), lands on a gravel path, and reaches a blue door marked with a white sign: "FIRE SAFETY DOOR / DO NOT OBSTRUCT / DO NOT KEEP OPEN" (~01:43-01:44), pushing it open.
visual: White balustrade, red chairs in distance, curved sheet-metal wall, gravel ground, blue fire door with printed white notice, bright sunlight and shadows.
audio: Footsteps on gravel, door latch click, panting, music.

caption: Through the fire door the runner descends an outdoor concrete stairwell; the Ghostface figure suddenly appears on the landing above, blade raised (~01:48-01:50). The runner vaults sideways over a low white painted wall (~01:51-01:54), dropping to the stairs below as the pursuer comes down after them.
visual: White-walled stairwell, metal handrail, tactile paving strips, greenery and brick building beyond. Masked figure framed at top of stairs. Runner's hands on wall during vault.
audio: Door creak, footfalls on steps, grunt on vault, music continues.

caption: The runner races down the remaining stairs, past a red-brick building, through a shaded covered walkway, and vaults a low maroon-painted wall (~02:05-02:06) into an open-air courtyard furnished with white-slab picnic tables on reddish-brown paving.
visual: Brick walls, concrete floor, chain-link fence, picnic tables with white seats, dappled shade, green lawn patch.
audio: Echoing steps in covered area, thump of vault landing, breathing, music.

caption: The runner climbs a short flight of concrete stairs with green metal railings; the Ghostface pursuer crests the top step with arms spread (~02:12). The runner vaults over the green railing (~02:13-02:14) back into the picnic-table zone and weaves between tables, leaping over one (~02:19-02:20) as the masked figure gives chase among the tables.
visual: Green railings, multiple white/green picnic tables, covered pavilion roof, school-style buildings with air conditioners behind. Masked figure prominent at stair top.
audio: Metal railing clank, footfalls on paving, panting, music driving.

caption: Exiting the table area, the runner sprints across open ground past a green lawn and trees, enters a long shaded pavilion lined with green slatted benches, passing a black banner with white text reading "With All Thy Might" (~02:28-02:31), then descends a stairway at the pavilion's end.
visual: Red-brown pavilion floor, dark posts, green benches, rocks and planting, banner text clearly legible, bright sun outside pavilion.
audio: Footsteps transition from open to covered, breathing, music continues.

caption: Below the pavilion the runner threads a landscaped path of concrete planter boxes and artificial turf, reaches a low red-brick wall with a small white warning sign (~02:40), drops off it onto asphalt (~02:42-02:43), crosses a courtyard with palm trees and a thatched-roof structure, and plunges through an open doorway into a dark building interior (~02:50).
visual: Grey planters, green turf, brick wall, yellow road markings, palm trunks, tiled corridor inside. Sign text partially readable: "WARNING ... Restricted Access ... Authorised Personnel Only".
audio: Footfalls on various surfaces, thud of drop, music still present but beginning to feel muffled indoors.

caption: Inside a dim public restroom with cream walls and blue stall doors, the runner hurries down the corridor, slips into an empty stall (~02:58-03:01), and pulls the blue door shut, pressing a hand to it. The chase music drops away, leaving echoing ambience and the runner's hushed breathing; they glance up at the ceiling (~03:04-03:06).
visual: Low light, blue laminate stall doors with metal hinges and latches, white grab rail, fluorescent tube on ceiling, small window high on wall.
audio: Music fades/stops; door slam and latch click; reverberant room tone; quiet panting.

caption: The runner climbs up onto the toilet/ledge to hide above the stall (~03:08-03:11). Footsteps echo as the Ghostface pursuer enters the restroom (~03:12-03:16), moving stall to stall searching; the masked figure approaches the runner's stall and looks around while the runner crouches above (~03:17-03:20). The image cuts to black as the pursuer discovers/attacks them.
visual: Dark stall interior, blue door, runner's legs tucked up; silhouette of masked figure with blade moving between stalls; final frames nearly black.
audio: Slow echoing footsteps, faint breathing, tense silence replacing music; abrupt cut/sting at blackout.

caption: Outro on a black screen: a YouTube-style subscription bar appears showing a circular profile icon, the channel name "Nick Rowley," and a red "SUBSCRIBE" button; an animated cursor clicks it, changing it to grey "SUBSCRIBED," then clicks the bell icon which rings. A calm male voiceover delivers the call to action before the video ends in silence.
visual: Black background, white/grey rounded rectangle UI bar, text "Nick Rowley," "SUBSCRIBE" in red then "SUBSCRIBED" in grey, bell icon with ring lines, dashed cursor trail.
audio: Silence except mouse-click sound effects and the voiceover; no music.
speech: "Please tap the subscribe button and watch another video."
